entry.name: trigger
entry.description: Outputs any input received in order from right to left and formatted according to the object-argument specified.

arguments.name: formats
arguments.description: The number of arguments determines the number of outlets. Each outlet sends out either int, float,, list, or symbol, as identified by symbol arguments (i, f, b, l, or s). If there are no arguments, there are two outlets, both of which send an int.

arguments.name: constant
arguments.description: When an int, float, or symbol is specified, the value is output as a constant.

messages.description: Causes either a, an integer, a float, a list, or an empty symbol to be sent out of each outlet.

messages.name: float
messages.description: The number is sent out each outlet in the form designated by the typed-in arguments: either an int, a float, a list, a symbol (although empty), or a.
